extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset containing 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, generated from HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website for Arabic OCR training and evaluation.
extraction.creator: Mohamed Rashad
extraction.citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad. Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835v1 [cs.CL], 19 November 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: HTML content was scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs, and used to generate paired Arabic book-page images and extracted Markdown text. The resulting synthetic dataset contains 13.7k paired samples.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website, https://www.hindawi.org/.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Scraped HTML content was converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to generate paired book-page images and Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Markdown representations paired with Arabic book-page images were generated through a pipeline that scraped Hindawi HTML content, converted it to PDFs, and extracted Markdown text. These representations served as ground-truth references for evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset addresses gaps in Arabic OCR resources and supports the paper's goal of promoting the digitization of underrepresented languages such as Arabic.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is derived from Hindawi's web content and may not generalize well to other Arabic text domains, including scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Its reliance on Hindawi web content may limit generalization to other Arabic text domains. The paper identifies expansion to diverse genres and styles as critical for improving model robustness.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of Arabic OCR and image-to-Markdown models. The dataset was used exclusively to train arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat. Evaluation used 160 randomly selected, unseen Arabic book pages from the dataset, paired with their Markdown representations.
